people.name: Darius Cole
people.bio: A licensed contractor for twelve years before real estate. He reads every inspection report line by line and knows what a fix really costs.

faq.a: Both of us. Maggie leads on pricing and negotiating, Darius on the house itself and the inspection.
It's negotiable and agreed in writing before any work starts.

faq.q: Do I need to sign anything to tour homes?
faq.a: Yes, a short written buyer agreement, as the rules now require. It says what we're paid and who pays it.
Light staging for photos is included on our listings. Full staging of a vacant home is quoted separately and is always your choice.
